verdicts.reason: A flips the hierarchy: the italic subline 'food & drinks' is set far larger than the 'Order online' headline and runs over the kraft box, and the two rules no longer frame the text block. B is worse: 'food & drinks' becomes a huge heading that collides with the cup, while the real headline 'Order online' shrinks to tiny text at the bottom, below its own supporting copy. That breaks both the hierarchy and the reading order.
